Light, and its many uses When most people think of hiding, they think of shadows and darkness. I am here to enlighten you. Pardon the obfuscatory humor. Light is as much a part of hiding as shadow. In order to truly remain unseen, you must be able to disappear under any conditions. How, then, can one disappear in broad daylight? Let us begin.
光，及其诸多用途 提起藏身，多数人想到的是阴影与黑暗。我在此为你「点破玄机」，请原谅这个故弄玄虚的双关。其实，光与影同为藏身的一部分。要想真正不被看见，你得能在任何环境下消失。那么，光天化日之下，人又该如何隐身？我们从头道来。
res#60478/whatIHaveToSay[1]
Start

Distraction is a necessary element in any attempt to go unseen. The more around you that draws attention, the easier it is to disappear, such as into a busy crowd or a windy field. Those are obvious, for the distractions often make themselves.

	Always carry on you something with which to cause a distraction in the environment you expect to be found in, as well as those you do not. A tossed coin can easily turn a busy street into a clamor.

任何隐身之举，都少不了「干扰」这一环。周围吸引注意的东西越多，你就越容易消失，比如混入熙攘的人群，或藏进风起草动之野。这两处显而易见，因为干扰往往自行出现。

	无论预计会陷入何种环境，甚至没预料到的环境，随身都要带着能制造干扰的物件。一枚掷出的硬币，就能让繁忙的街道瞬间哗然。
res#60478/whatIHaveToSay[2]
Start

A smoke bomb, while unsubtle, can allow you to travel in an unexpected direction. A mirror, or piece of shined metal can throw the light at your pursuers long enough to escape.

	There is another element to a distraction, which I have already hinted at. When a man loses his quarry, his mind deduces where it might have gone, whether he does so knowingly or not. This is the second aspect that must be understood. At all costs, avoid going where your enemy expects.

烟弹虽然谈不上含蓄，却能掩护你往出人意料的方向脱身。一面镜子、一块抛光的金属，可以把光反照向追兵，为你争取足够的逃脱时间。

	干扰之中还有另一层要素，我已暗示过：当一个人丢失了猎物，他的脑子会自动推断猎物可能去了哪里，无论他是否自知。这是必须领悟的第二点：无论如何，别去敌人以为你会去的方向。
res#60478/whatIHaveToSay[3]
Start

If using a smoke bomb in an alley, go up, or towards your enemy. Only go away from them if you believe you truly can escape. Remember that in situations in which you are found and cornered you can expect a repeat of those circumstances. You have only escaped when your pursuers give up.

	Perhaps, you use the sun to temporarily blind your foe. If there is enough motion near you, consider not moving at all, except to drop low and avoid eyes.

若在小巷里用烟弹，那就往上走，或迎着敌人走。除非确信真能逃脱，否则不要背身而逃。要记住：一旦被寻见、被逼入死角，同样的处境还会重演。你的追兵放弃时，你才算真的逃脱了。

	也许，你可以借太阳暂耀敌人的眼。若四周足够喧动，不妨索性不动，只矮身伏低，避开目光。

It will be assumed that you have run.

	At all avenues, beat the expectations of your opponents. To do this, you must also know their expectations. Study your enemy. Get to know them. Whether man or beast, each creature has motivations and expectations.

他们会想当然地以为你已经跑了。

	在任何环节上，都要抢在对手的预料之前。要做到这一点，你必须先了解他们所预料的。研究你的敌人，熟悉他们。无论人还是兽，每个生灵都有自己的动机与预判。
res#60478/whatIHaveToSay[5]

Next, we will discuss shadow. Be sure to practice at all times. Always be aware. These are just notes. The real challenge is putting them into practice. Until our next lesson...


- Shadvarin, Secretkeeper of the Blue Hand.

下一课，我们谈谈阴影。务必时时练习，时时警觉。这些只是笔记，真正的难处在于付诸实践。下堂课见……


沙德瓦林，蓝手会的守密人。
